property_summary: For all callers, calling setOwner only changes C.owner when the caller is the current owner (i.e., after any call to setOwner by caller A, C.owner() == A iff A was the prior owner); the mutant removing the onlyOwner check allows a non-owner caller to change owner, violating this rule.
change_summary: Delete the require check so onlyOwner modifier no longer enforces any condition, allowing anyone to call protected functions.
